title: Lisbon, the bed
logline: The Lisbon hotel's bed, from the doorway: made, tight, a window's shutter-light striped across it, a coat on the chair — green. The room he built behind a postcard, furnished one piece at a time.

panels.composition: A hotel room from its doorway: a tightly made bed with shutter-light striped across it, tile floor, a wooden chair with a green coat over its back, a postcard on the nightstand. No one.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a bright hotel room from its doorway with a tightly made bed striped by light through shutters, a patterned tile floor, a wooden chair with a green coat over it and a postcard on the nightstand, no one, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
